newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Bomb blast wounds 19 in Pakistani market.
newsitem.headline: Bomb blast wounds 19 in Pakistani market.

text.p: A bomb exploded in a crowded market in Pakistan's central province of Punjab on Wednesday, wounding at least 19 people, doctors and police said.
The blast in the town of Gujranwala occurred at a shoe store that had attracted a large crowd by holding a cut-price sale, police said.
Nobody claimed responsibility for the blast and there was no immediate information on who detonated the bomb.

A doctor at a government hospital in Gujranwala, 60 km (38 miles) north of the provincial capital Lahore, said most of the wounded, who included women and children, had shrapnel wounds. Two were in serious condition.
In January, a bomb blast in Lahore killed 26 people and wounded 90.
